New temple: shares $100 to raise $50,000; lot 6th & Broadway $24,000. Building & Finance Committee: Wm. Kriegshaber Chairman; S. Lieberman; A. Starr [prob]; N. Bloom; T. Beerman [uncertain]; S. Sep 14 same officers. Sep 2 1869 N. Bloom Pres., Jno. Flexner V.P.
